title: Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer
description:
Job Title: Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer

About the Company:

Our Client is a dynamic organization focused on creating high-conversion advertising content for a variety of social media platforms. They prioritize direct-response advertising and are dedicated to optimizing creative strategies to improve ad performance.

What You’ll Do:

Our Client is seeking a skilled Video and Image Ad Editor to create high-performing advertising content for paid social platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in editing video ads and designing image ads that drive conversions.

Core Responsibilities:

• Edit high-performing video ads for platforms such as Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok.

• Transform raw footage, UGC, and creator content into conversion-focused ads with strong hooks, pacing, and retention strategies.

• Design compelling image ads that balance typography, hierarchy, and visual clarity to drive clicks and conversions.

• Create multiple creative variations to support testing strategies and improve ad performance.

• Apply on-image text that is clear, scroll-stopping, and aligned with brand voice.

• Ensure all assets are optimized for platform specs, placements, and mobile-first viewing.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience editing video specifically for e-commerce or direct-response advertising.

• Strong understanding of what makes paid social creative convert, including hooks, pacing, captions, CTAs, and pattern interrupts.

• Ability to create a variety of video ad styles (UGC-inspired, promotional, testimonial, feature-focused, offer-driven).

• Demonstrated ability to design high-quality text-driven image ads built to sell.

• Excellent typography skills, including text hierarchy, readability, spacing, and composition.

• Comfortable producing creative at volume without sacrificing quality.

• Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or similar.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow best practices and legal guidelines while exploring new creative directions.

• Ability to take direction, implement feedback quickly, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with direct-response formats and UGC-style editing.

• Familiarity with before/after iterations or creative variations.

Personality:

• Creative thinker with a keen eye for detail.

• Adaptable and open to feedback and new ideas.

• Strong communicator with the ability to work well under pressure.

Software & Tools:

• Adobe Creative Suite

• Premiere

• Photoshop

• Illustrator

• After Effects or similar tools.

English Level:

C2

Schedule:

9-5 EST

Salary and Benefits:

• Payment in USD or Local Currency according to candidate's preference.

  • Familiarity with tools such as Google Workspace, Notion, Slack, and basic CRM systems

description:
VAGA: Coordenador(a) EHS – Brasil (Environment, Health & Safety)

Sobre a posição

Na Ascenty Data Centers, buscamos uma liderança para fortalecer a cultura de Segurança, Saúde e Meio Ambiente (EHS) nas nossas operações no Brasil, com foco em prevenção, conformidade e excelência operacional em infraestrutura crítica.

title: Business Development Representative
description:
Job Title: Outreach Specialist / Appointment Setter

Schedule: Full-time (40 hs/week).

Location: Fully remote, async-first.

About This Role:

Our client is looking for a dedicated and hungry Outreach Specialist to fuel their sales pipeline. This is a junior-to-mid-level role for a "hunter" who thrives on chasing leads and booking qualified meetings. You will be the engine of the sales process, responsible for the initial contact that turns cold prospects into warm opportunities.

We are looking for an Operator , not just a list-builder. You must be able to execute high-volume outreach across multiple channels (Cold Call, Email, LinkedIn) and diagnose what is working to optimize your results.

Responsibilities:

  • Meeting Generation: Your primary KPI is the number of qualified meetings booked per week and per month.
  • Omnichannel Outreach: Execute campaigns using Cold Calling, Email, and LinkedIn. You have the autonomy to use the channels that yield the best results.
  • Metric Tracking: Meticulously track your daily activity (volume of outreach) and your success rates (meetings booked).
  • Pipeline Management: Ensure no lead falls through the cracks; manage follow-ups religiously until a "No" or a "Yes" is achieved.
  • Feedback Loop: Provide feedback to the strategy team on lead quality and market response to improve targeting.

Requirements:

  • 2-3 years of experience (Minimum) in outreach, appointment setting, or SDR roles.
  • Proven Track Record: Must be able to demonstrate historical success rates (specifically: Average Meetings Generated per Month) from previous roles.
  • Tool Agnostic: Experience with any standard outreach tools (e.g., Apollo, Lemlist, Sales Navigator, RingCentral) is accepted.
  • High Availability: Willingness to work 40 hours/week.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal English skills for cold calling and email copywriting.

In this role, you will shape the market presence, build lasting retail partnerships, and contribute directly to the brand’s positioning as premium, fashionable, and tech-forward.   • Hold a Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field.

  • Known for your resilience, proactive mindset, and drive to exceed targets.

WHY JOIN US

You’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of a brand in the open market, work with leading retail partners, and grow within a collaborative, forward-thinking team.

description:

STORAGE JOB DESCRIPTION:

  • Advanced English
  • Good Knowledge on components and architectures.
  • In depth understanding of the HPE Alletra, HP 3PAR, Nimble.
  • Hands on experience with storage array migrations.
  • Experience in SAN storage backup and recovery and exposure to SAN Data replication tools.
  • Experience on Cisco and Brocade fabric switch/Directors. Configuring new switch, upgrades, zoning, VSAN and troubleshooting.
  • Experience of SAN allocation, deallocation.
  • Good Knowledge on RAID concepts, inline data deduplication, inline data compression.
  • Dynamic LUN Provisioning, Zoning, storage firmware upgrades
  • Allocating Boot luns in VMware environment
  • Troubleshooting storage related and compatibility related issues.
  • Allocating LUNs to different operating systems like MS Windows, VMWare ESX/ESXi, Linux and Solaris/AIX/HPUX.
  • Exposure to performance tuning techniques for SAN and NAS
  • Experience in handling major incident bridges, critical issues.
  • Good in scripting and automating the standard storage procedures.
  • Should be familiar with ITIL processes.

Roles & Responsibilities – Storage (HPE 3PAR / Alletra)

1. Design, architect, and deploy HPE 3PAR and Alletra storage solutions based on customer business, performance, and availability requirements.

2. Lead technical discussions with customers and internal stakeholders to understand workload needs and propose optimal storage designs.

3. Manage 3PAR/Alletra arrays including CPGs, virtual volumes, VLUNs, host sets, and port configurations.

4. Perform advanced troubleshooting and root cause analysis (RCA) for complex storage, SAN, and performance issues.

5. Plan and execute storage migrations using Peer Motion, Online Import, and host-based migration tools with minimal downtime.

6. Administer and troubleshoot SAN fabrics (Brocade/Cisco) including zoning, ISLs, firmware upgrades, and fabric resiliency.

7. Optimize storage performance and efficiency through RAID selection, tiering, chunklet layout, and adaptive optimization.

8. Implement and manage replication and DR solutions such as Remote Copy, Peer Persistence, and metro cluster configurations.

9. Integrate storage with virtualization and OS platforms (VMware, Hyper-V, Linux, Windows) and resolve multipathing issues.

10. Manage firmware, OS, and controller upgrades ensuring non-disruptive operations and rollback readiness.

11. Leverage HPE InfoSight and SSMC for proactive monitoring, capacity forecasting, and health analysis.

12. Coordinate with backup teams and customers to integrate storage with Commvault / NetBackup for application-consistent backups.

13. Prepare and deliver technical presentations to customers on storage architecture, performance analysis, and solution proposals.

14. Provide regular operational and executive-level reports covering capacity utilization, performance trends, risks, and recommendations.

15. Act as escalation point for critical production incidents and major outages.

16. Collaborate with application, database, network, and virtualization teams to align storage design with end-to-end solutions.

17. Ensure security, compliance, and governance through encryption, RBAC, audit logging, and best-practice controls.

18. Automate and standardize storage operations using CLI, REST APIs, and scripting to improve efficiency and reliability.

19. Mentor L1/L2 engineers and review change requests, SOPs, and implementation plans.

20. Participate in CAB meetings, customer reviews, and vendor engagements (HPE) while supporting 24×7 mission-critical environments.

title: Graphic Designer (B2B Marketing)
description:
Graphic Designer (B2B Marketing)

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced Graphic Designer to join our marketing team and help bring our brand and services to life across print and digital channels. This role is ideal for a designer with a strong background in B2B marketing , who can translate complex ideas into clear, compelling visuals that inform, engage, and inspire professional audiences.

The Graphic Designer will collaborate closely with marketing and business development to create high-quality assets that align with brand standards and support business goals. From concept through execution, this role plays a key part in ensuring visual consistency and excellence across all customer touchpoints.

Note: please provide link to portfolio of work. Applications without a portfolio will not be accepted.

Key Responsibilities

Design & Creative Execution

  • Design a wide range of B2B marketing materials for print and digital use
  • Print: brochures, flyers, one-pagers, case studies, white papers, sales collateral, event signage, conference materials, stationery, and promotional items
  • Digital: website and landing page assets, display ads, social media posts and ads, email graphics, evergreen content, case studies, white papers, and presentations
  • Translate creative briefs, written concepts, and strategic direction into high-quality visual designs within established brand guidelines
  • Develop original design concepts using typography, color, imagery, layout, and visual hierarchy to communicate key messages effectively
  • Adapt designs for multiple formats, channels, and screen sizes (desktop, tablet, mobile)

Brand & Quality Management

  • Maintain and evolve brand consistency across all visual materials
  • Prepare final production-ready files for print and digital use, ensuring correct formats, resolutions, and color profiles
  • Create and maintain templates (social media, email, presentations, one-pagers, etc.) to improve team efficiency and brand consistency
  • Organize and maintain internal design libraries, assets, photography, and files

Digital & Web Support

  • Design assets to support websites and landing pages, ensuring responsive, user-friendly experiences
  • Collaborate with web teams and work within content management systems (CMS) as needed
  • Stay current on digital design best practices, UX/UI, accessibility standards, and usability trends

Collaboration & Project Management

  • Collaborate with marketing and business development teams to support campaigns, initiatives, and events
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously, balancing priorities and meeting deadlines in a fast-paced environment
  • Incorporate feedback efficiently and professionally while maintaining high design standards
  • Identify opportunities to improve workflows, processes, and design systems

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Graphic Design, Visual Communications, Fine Arts, or a related field (or equivalent professional experience)
  • 3–5+ years of professional graphic design experience , preferably in a B2B environment (in-house or agency)
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating B2B design work across both print and digital media
  • Expert proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (Illustrator, InDesign, Photoshop)
  • Working experience with modern design and collaboration tools such as Figma (or similar)
  • Solid understanding of: typography, layout, color theory, and visual hierarchy; designing for both print production and digital platforms; UX/UI
  • Experience creating web-ready assets that are mobile, tablet, and desktop-friendly
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and time-management skills
  • Ability to work independently while contributing effectively within a team
  • Comfortable receiving and applying constructive feedback

Preferred / Nice-to-Have Skills

  • Experience designing for B2B marketing, SaaS, IT, and technology-driven organizations
  • Familiarity with HTML5, CSS3 , and basic front-end concepts
  • Experience working with WordPress or other CMS platforms
  • Knowledge of motion graphics, animation, or video editing (After Effects, Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro, etc.)
  • Experience with photography or photo direction
  • Understanding of current design trends, accessibility standards (WCAG), and digital marketing best practices

What We’re Looking For

  • A creative problem-solver who can balance aesthetics with strategy
  • A detail-oriented designer who takes pride in high-quality execution
  • A proactive self-starter who brings fresh ideas and stays current with evolving design trends
  • A team player who enjoys collaboration and contributing to larger business goals

description:

Buscamos ampliar a representatividade racial e territorial no mercado de comunicação e design, incentivando candidaturas de mulheres negras/indígenas, e profissionais localizadas nas regiões Norte e Nordeste do Brasil.

Objetivo da posição

  • Desenvolver peças de motion design para diferentes plataformas digitais, apoiando estratégias de comunicação por meio de conteúdos animados claros, didáticos e visualmente consistentes com a identidade da marca a ser trabalhada.

  • Criar motions a partir de layouts estáticos (cards, infográficos, apresentações, peças editoriais);
  • Apoiar edição básica de vídeo (cortes, ajustes de ritmo, inserção de legendas e elementos gráficos);
  • Adaptar peças para diferentes formatos e plataformas (Instagram, LinkedIn, YouTube, apresentações, landing pages);
  • Garantir consistência visual e aderência à identidade da marca e aos guias de estilo;
  • Apoiar a equipe de design na elaboração e ajustes de materiais gráficos diversos;
  • Organizar arquivos, versões e entregas conforme fluxos acordados;
  • Trabalhar de forma integrada com equipes de conteúdo, social media, design gráfico e estratégia;

Requisitos técnicos obrigatórios

Formação em andamento ou concluída em Design Gráfico, Design Digital, Audiovisual, Comunicação Visual ou áreas correlatas;

Domínio intermediário de:

  • After Effects (essencial);
  • Premiere Pro (ou equivalente para edição básica);
  • Illustrator e/ou Photoshop para preparação de assets;
  • PowerPoint

Noções de:

  • Tipografia animada;
  • Ritmo, timing e hierarquia visual;
  • Formatos e especificações para redes sociais;

Portfólio com exemplos de motion design (acadêmicos ou autorais são bem-vindos).

Requisitos desejáveis (não eliminatórios)

  • Noções de storytelling visual e narrativa audiovisual;
  • Incorporar feedbacks de forma ágil e construtiva.
  • Familiaridade com animações explicativas, vídeos institucionais ou conteúdos educativos;
  • Conhecimento básico de: Animação de infográficos; Templates animados; Figma (para leitura e adaptação de layouts);
  • Interesse por tendências de design, vídeo e comunicação digital;
  • Experiência prévia em agência, estúdio ou projetos colaborativos.

Competências comportamentais esperadas

  • Organização e atenção a detalhes;
  • Capacidade de receber e aplicar feedback com maturidade;
  • Curiosidade e disposição para aprender continuamente;
  • Responsabilidade com prazos e entregas;
  • Comunicação clara e colaborativa;
  • Capacidade de atuar em múltiplos projetos simultaneamente, com orientação.

Entregáveis típicos

  • Vídeos animados curtos (15s a 60s);
  • Animações de cards e carrosséis;
  • Vinhetas e aberturas simples;
  • Animações de dados, textos e infográficos;
  • Desdobramentos animados de campanhas e apresentações.

Como o portfólio será avaliado

Serão considerados:

  • Clareza conceitual;
  • Domínio técnico;
  • Coerência visual;
  • Criatividade e capacidade de resolução de problemas;
  • Adequação ao formato digital.

Desenvolvimento e crescimento

  • Aprendizado contínuo em projetos reais;
  • Interação com profissionais mais experientes da área criativa;
  • Evolução técnica em motion design aplicado à comunicação estratégica;
  • Exposição a diferentes formatos, públicos e narrativas.

SignalPET is a fast-growing veterinary AI company working alongside veterinarians and radiologists to deliver faster, more accurate diagnostic support. Our mission is to enhance clinical decision-making through intelligent technology grounded in real-world veterinary medicine.

We are expanding our Medical R&D team in Brazil and are looking for a clinically strong, detail-oriented veterinarian to help build and refine the medical intelligence powering our platform.

The Role

As a Veterinarian – Medical Education & Medical Content , you will transform real SignalPET clinical cases into structured educational modules and high-quality medical marketing content.

You will help build and execute the SignalPET Training Hub & Academy , including CE-accredited learning modules, case-based training, and medical campaigns that strengthen veterinarians’ radiology skills and reinforce SignalPET’s clinical authority.

This is a highly collaborative, cross-functional role working closely with:

  • Board-certified radiologists
  • Medical R&D
  • AI and Product teams
  • Marketing

Key Responsibilities

Academy & CE Content Development

  • Develop structured, case-based learning modules using real SignalPET cases
  • Create CE-accredited courses, micro-learning sessions, pathology refreshers, and interactive quizzes
  • Build AI vs. Radiologist comparison educational insights
  • Work with specialists to validate medical accuracy
  • Manage and publish modules inside the Training Hub platform

Medical Marketing Content

  • Write clinically authoritative blogs, case spotlights, white papers, landing page content, and educational campaigns
  • Develop product-related medical materials and sales enablement tools
  • Collaborate with marketing to align messaging and positioning
  • Ensure scientific credibility through specialist validation

Workflow-Connected Learning

  • Map common clinical findings (e.g., splenic masses, thoracic disease, trauma cases) to relevant Academy modules
  • Collaborate with AI and Product teams to connect case workflows with learning opportunities

Performance & Optimization

  • Define and track CE engagement, learning participation, and content performance metrics
  • Continuously refine modules based on user feedback and clinical data

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Participate in relevant internal meetings
  • Provide medical clarification for marketing and product initiatives
  • Coordinate with specialists and Medical R&D for content validation

Requirements

  • Doctor of Veterinary Medicine (DVM) or equivalent
  • Clinical Experience - Hands-on experience in small animal practice
  • Strong radiographic interpretation skills (canine & feline)
  • Radiology-focused experience is a plus
  • Excellent English writing skills (medical & educational content)
  • Ability to translate complex medical topics into clear, structured content
  • Experience creating CE-accredited content is a strong advantage
  • Strong small animal radiology knowledge
  • Ability to collaborate with board-certified specialists
  • Understanding of adult learning principles
  • Comfortable working in CMS and digital platforms

Working Hours

  • Monday to Friday - 7am to 4pm

Why Join SignalPET?

  • Work at the intersection of veterinary medicine and AI
  • Impact thousands of veterinary professionals globally
  • Remote flexibility
  • Be part of a growing, mission-driven team

High performing interns may be considered for future opportunities within the organisation.

Click the Apply Now button and complete the application process through this platform.

title: Arquiteto de Integração
description:
Estamos em busca de um Arquiteto de Integração altamente qualificado para atuar em projetos de grande complexidade e impacto estratégico. O profissional será responsável por garantir a evolução arquitetural e tecnológica das integrações corporativas, promovendo soluções eficientes, escaláveis e aderentes às melhores práticas de mercado. Esta posição exige sólida capacidade analítica, profundo conhecimento técnico e forte atuação colaborativa com times multidisciplinares.

Responsabilidades:

  • Analisar, desenhar e manter o desenho de solução de integração para múltiplos projetos e sistemas;
  • Avaliar a arquitetura AS-IS e projetar a solução TO-BE , elaborando documentos técnicos de arquitetura de integração, definindo datamapping , swagger das APIs e garantindo aderência ao TMFórum, OpenAPI e 4P , conforme a arquitetura de referência;
  • Realizar análise técnica de requisitos, identificando sistemas impactados e definindo a solução de integração mais apropriada;
  • Garantir o desenvolvimento e a implantação das soluções de integração;
  • Acompanhar o ciclo completo de desenvolvimento das integrações, assegurando qualidade técnica e cumprimento de prazos;
  • Projetar, especificar e implementar APIs e Microserviços (criação e evolução), apoiando iniciativas de transformação digital;
  • Desenvolver backends utilizando Spring, SpringBoot e Node.js .;
  • Contribuir para a avaliação e implantação de novas tecnologias e práticas DevOps;
  • Orientar, acompanhar e validar o desenvolvimento realizado pela equipe (Júnior, Pleno e Sênior);
  • Realizar troubleshooting técnico;
  • Acompanhar implantações em produção e dar suporte ao início da operação;
  • Elaborar estimativas de esforço de desenvolvimento.

Requisitos:

Obrigatórios:

  • Experiência em desenvolvimento utilizando arquitetura de Microserviços;
  • Conhecimento em padrões de segurança para microserviços: JWT , protocolo OAUTH , SSL 2Way;
  • Domínio em desenvolvimento de API REST;
  • Conhecimento em SOA – Arquitetura Orientada a Serviços;
  • Vivência em soluções com arquitetura distribuída, microserviços e arquitetura orientada a eventos;
  • Conhecimento em automação de testes;
  • Experiência com Java e frameworks como Spring, SpringBoot, Maven, JUnit;
  • Experiência com mensageria e eventos via Kafka (consumo e publicação);
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais;
  • Conhecimento de padrões e conceitos de exposição de APIs via API Gateway;
  • Experiência com Oracle SOA Suite 11g/12c (OSB, BPEL, BAM, Rules);
  • Experiência com Oracle Service Bus 11g/12c;
  • Experiência com Web Services (RESTful e SOAP);
  • Conhecimento em Enterprise Manager, DVN, XML, WSDL, WADL, XSD, JSON, xQuery, xPath, Java e PL/SQL;
  • Experiência com modelagem de entidades canônicas (SID);
  • Conhecimento de TMForum;
  • Experiência comprovada em ambientes com grande demanda por integrações;
  • Vivência com JIRA, Quality Center, Jenkins, SVN e GIT .

Desejável:

  • Conhecimento em plataformas de contêiner, especialmente Kubernetes;
  • Conhecimento em pipelines CI/CD;
  • Conhecimento em DataPower;
  • Experiência no setor Telecom .

title: Java Fullstack Developer (Angular)
description:
About You

You are a software engineer who enjoys building robust, scalable, and well-structured applications. You’re motivated by clean architecture, modern technologies, and meaningful collaboration across backend and frontend layers. You’re looking for a place where you can grow professionally, influence technical decisions, and contribute to high-impact products used by real customers.

You Bring to Applaudo the Following Competencies:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related field.
  • 6+ years of professional experience developing backend solutions using Java (21+) and Spring Boot.
  • Strong experience building and maintaining monolithic backend applications following clean architecture principles.
  • Hands-on experience with PostgreSQL and in-memory data stores such as Redis.
  • Proven experience working with AWS services, including S3, ECS, CloudWatch, and Bedrock.
  • Experience using MyBatis as an ORM and Liquibase for database versioning and migrations.
  • 2+ years of professional experience with Angular (v19 or similar), with strong usage of RxJS and Observables.
  • Familiarity with frontend monolith architectures and modern client-side frameworks.
  • Advanced knowledge of Git and version control best practices.
  • Advanced English proficiency is required, as you will work directly with US-based clients.

You Will Be Accountable for the Following Responsibilities:

  • Participate in collaborative concept definition, architectural refinement, and software design across backend and frontend layers.
  • Design, build, and maintain scalable monolithic applications using Java 21 and Spring Boot.
  • Develop and maintain RESTful APIs and integrate them with Angular frontend applications using RxJS and Observables.
  • Implement and manage data persistence using PostgreSQL, MyBatis, Liquibase, and Redis.
  • Work with AWS infrastructure services (S3, ECS, CloudWatch, Bedrock) to support application deployment, monitoring, and observability.
  • Follow Agile practices, working independently while collaborating closely with a cross-functional team.
  • Maintain high-quality technical documentation throughout the SDLC.

Qualifications

  • Hands-on experience with: Java 21, Spring Boot, PostgreSQL, Redis, Monolithic architecture design and development, AWS (S3, ECS, CloudWatch), Angular (v19 or similar), RxJS / Observables, MyBatis and Liquibase.
  • Strong communication skills in English and Spanish.

Additional Information

About Us

At Applaudo , we partner with ambitious companies to transform through technology with an AI-native mindset at the core of how we think, build, and deliver. We combine strategic clarity, world-class execution, and modern engineering practices to help clients accelerate measurable business outcomes and stay competitive.

We are building a high-performance culture grounded in five values: Empowering Excellence, Collaborative Teamwork, Unsolicited Respect, Consistent Transparency, and Efficient Communication. These define how we work, how we make decisions, and how we hold ourselves accountable.

Applaudo is a place for people who want to grow fast, take ownership, and work alongside strong teams. Joining us means being part of an organization that is evolving intentionally, investing in modern ways of working, and embracing AI as a lever for productivity, innovation, and impact.

title: Analista Fiscal Sênior
description:
Quem somos?

A primeira unidade da AMAGGI, a Sementes Maggi, foi inaugurada em 1977 na cidade de São Miguel do Iguaçu, no Paraná. Dois anos depois, em 1979, tiveram início as atividades em Mato Grosso, com a aquisição de uma fazenda no município de Itiquira.

Desde então, a empresa tem ampliado suas unidades e áreas de negócios, expandindo a atuação no Brasil e no exterior. Com sede em Cuiabá (MT), é hoje a maior companhia brasileira na cadeia de grãos e fibras do país e está presente também na China, Argentina, Paraguai, Holanda, Noruega, Singapura e Suíça.

Além disso, desde 1997 contribui para o desenvolvimento local e humano nas comunidades onde atua, colocando-se como parceira no desenvolvimento sustentável dessas localidades por meio da Fundação André e Lucia Maggi.

Sobre a vaga

Atribuições:

  • Atuará na célula de Apuração dos Impostos Estaduais;
  • Apuração de ICMS;
  • Entrega de obrigações acessórias estaduais;
  • Entre outros.

Requisitos Necessários:

  • Graduação Completa em Ciências Contábeis e área relacionadas;
  • Experiência na parte fiscal ou tributária;
  • Conhecimento em ICMS, especialmente na legislação de Mato Grosso;
  • Passagem por empresas do ramo do agronegócio será um grande diferencial.

*Nossas oportunidades são abertas para todos os profissionais, sem distinção de raça, cor, gênero, idade, crença e deficiência (PCD)*

title: B2B Growth Lead
description:
Company Description

The Institute of Project Management (IPM) is a globally recognized leader in project management education, certification, membership, and research, with over 35 years of experience. IPM has empowered more than 50,000 professionals and certified over 6,000 Project Managers while partnering with 1000+ organizations worldwide. Known for its integrated, three-stage professional journey, IPM supports career progression from Project Management to Project Directorship. The organization collaborates with top certification bodies, universities, and industry leaders to shape international project management standards. IPM is committed to inclusivity and accessibility through initiatives like IPM Hub, mentorship programs, and regional events.

Role Overview

This is a full-time remote role for a B2B Growth Lead focused on building and scaling IPM’s outbound and partner-led revenue engine. You will own B2B outreach end-to-end, from identifying the right accounts to initiating conversations and moving qualified opportunities into structured sales discussions. This role sits at the intersection of strategy and execution and works closely with leadership to continuously refine how we go to market.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own B2B outreach end-to-end across email, LinkedIn, and partner-led channels
  • Research and identify high-fit accounts, organisations, and decision-makers
  • Craft thoughtful, personalised outreach messages that start meaningful conversations
  • Initiate and manage early-stage conversations with prospects and partners
  • Qualify opportunities and progress them into structured sales discussions with the wider sales team
  • Collaborate closely with leadership to refine targeting, messaging, and outreach strategy
  • Track outreach activity, responses, and outcomes, using data to improve conversion and effectiveness over time

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to personalise outreach and build rapport
  • Proven experience in B2B outreach, lead generation, or early-stage sales conversations
  • Comfort researching accounts and navigating decision-maker conversations
  • A structured, organised approach to tracking outreach and follow-ups (CRM familiarity preferred)
  • Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote environment
  • Experience working with corporate clients, partnerships, or professional services is a plus
  • Exposure to education, training, or professional certification environments is helpful but not required

title: Senior Backend Engineer
description:
Senior Backend Engineer (Stripe & Fintech Specialist)

Contract: 6–12 months (with possibility of extension)

Engagement Model: Independent Contractor (PJ)

Role Overview

We are looking for a Senior Backend Engineer with deep expertise in Stripe Connect to lead the evolution of a critical payment infrastructure.

This role will be responsible for architecting and implementing a robust Stripe Connect integration within a core Django API, supporting the migration from a legacy Ruby on Rails payment portal.

You will lead the end-to-end payment lifecycle - from onboarding and funds flow to webhook orchestration and complex business logic - ensuring scalability, security, and reliability across payment operations.

Core Responsibilities

  • Architect and implement Stripe Connect integrations (Standard, Express, or Custom) within a Django/Python environment
  • Design and build complex payment flows (split payments, payouts, fee collection)
  • Develop resilient, idempotent webhook processing systems for real-time Stripe events
  • Lead migration of payment logic and data from a legacy Ruby on Rails application into a Django-based architecture
  • Integrate Stripe events with core backend workflows and business processes
  • Implement asynchronous processing using Celery and Redis for high-volume payment tasks
  • Ensure adherence to PCI-DSS standards and best practices for financial data security
  • Build monitoring, alerting, and logging for payment flows (Datadog, Sentry, or similar tools)
  • Write comprehensive unit and integration tests, maintaining high test coverage

Technical Stack

Backend: Python 3.11+, Django 4.x, Django REST Framework (DRF)

Payments: Stripe (Connect, Billing, Webhooks)

Task Queue: Celery, Redis, RabbitMQ (Amazon MQ)

Database: PostgreSQL (Aurora Serverless v2)

Infrastructure: AWS (ECS Fargate, ElastiCache)

What We’re Looking For

  • Strong experience building production-grade payment systems
  • Deep understanding of Stripe Connect and marketplace payment architectures
  • Experience migrating legacy systems to modern backend frameworks
  • Solid knowledge of asynchronous architectures and event-driven systems
  • Strong ownership mindset and ability to lead complex backend initiatives

title: Manufacturing Engineer
description:
Greenlane Renewables Inc., headquartered in metro Vancouver, Canada, is driving change: accelerating the energy transition. We are cleaning up two of the largest and most difficult-to-decarbonize sectors of the global energy system: the natural gas grid and commercial transportation. As a pioneer and leading global specialist in biogas desulfurization and upgrading, we have been actively contributing to the decarbonization of our planet for over 35 years with more than 500 systems supplied into 32 countries. We transform biogas generated from organic waste into high-value grid-ready renewable natural gas (“RNG”) from a wide range of sources such as landfills, sugar mills, dairy farms, wastewater, and food waste. Greenlane is transforming energy production and creating new, sustainable revenue streams for its customers - all while dramatically reducing carbon emissions. Join us, let’s accelerate the energy transition together.

The Manufacturing Engineer is responsible for defining, optimizing, and sustaining safe, efficient, and repeatable manufacturing and testing processes for large Renewable Natural Gas (RNG) equipment. This role ensures manufacturing operations consistently meet Safety, Quality, Cost, and Delivery (SQCD) objectives through structured process design, documentation, and continuous improvement.

Key Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and optimize assembly processes for large RNG equipment, ensuring compliance with engineering specifications and safety requirements.
  • Develop and maintain assembly procedures, work instructions, SOPs, and control plans.
  • Lead the transition from engineering to production, ensuring tooling, documentation, training, and test readiness.
  • Develop and execute testing protocols to validate equipment performance, safety, and compliance.
  • Analyze, document, and report test results in accordance with applicable standards.
  • Drive continuous improvement to enhance testing accuracy, efficiency, and repeatability.
  • Apply Lean, Six Sigma, and Industrial Engineering principles (time studies, capacity modeling, line balancing, takt analysis).
  • Lead Kaizen events, value stream mapping, 5S, standardized work, and waste reduction initiatives.
  • Conduct root cause analysis (A3, 5 Whys, Fishbone) and implement corrective actions.
  • Ensure manufacturing processes comply with internal quality standards and external regulatory requirements.
  • Conduct audits and inspections of manufacturing and testing activities.
  • Support incoming inspection, non-conformance management, and corrective action processes.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams (engineering, quality, supply chain, maintenance).
  • Train and mentor manufacturing personnel on processes, safety, and best practices.
  • Promote a strong safety culture and ensure compliance with environmental, health, and safety regulations.

Qualifications & Experience:

title: Líder de Crescimento de Varejo - Lojas Físicas
description:
Somos uma startup de IA criada para o varejo - e estamos procurando profissionais de varejo.

A STOREE.AI é uma startup em crescimento que leva IA para lojas físicas de forma prática e pé no chão.

Ajudamos organizações de varejo a conduzirem melhor as operações do dia a dia - comunicação, tarefas, prioridades, acompanhamentos e KPIs - usando uma IA que funciona como um ótimo gestor.

Você não precisa ter background técnico.

Sem experiência com software. Sem conhecimento em IA.

Se você entende como o varejo realmente funciona - pessoas, pressão, execução e tomada de decisão - você já tem exatamente o que buscamos.

Nós construímos a tecnologia.

Você traz a experiência de varejo.

Essa é a parceria.

O que fazemos:

A STOREE.AI é usada diariamente por mais de 100 redes de lojas no mundo.

A plataforma fica no centro das operações da loja e ajuda gestores a:

  • Comunicar com clareza com lojas e equipes
  • Transformar prioridades em tarefas executáveis
  • Fazer follow-up de forma automática e consistente
  • Acompanhar performance e KPIs em tempo real
  • Treinar e orientar equipes no trabalho do dia a dia, não em apresentações

Ela é familiar para quem é do varejo, porque foi construída em torno de como os bons gestores já operam - só que mais rápido, mais claro e em escala.

Por que a experiência de varejo importa:

Nossa plataforma é poderosa, mas varejo não é “tamanho único”.

O que importa para uma rede de moda não é o mesmo que importa para um supermercado.

O que um líder de VM procura é diferente do que HR/RH ou Operações procuram.

Por isso, não estamos buscando vendedores tradicionais.

Estamos buscando profissionais seniores de varejo que consigam:

  • Entender as necessidades reais de uma organização de varejo
  • Ajudar a moldar o “gestor de IA” certo para cada rede
  • Falar a linguagem do varejo, não buzzwords
  • Conduzir conversas com credibilidade e profundidade

Isso é desenvolvimento de negócios baseado em entendimento, não em “pitch”.

O que você vai fazer na prática:

  • Construir relacionamentos com organizações de varejo relevantes
  • Iniciar conversas usando nossas ferramentas de IA (treinamento completo incluído)
  • Mostrar como a STOREE.AI se encaixa na realidade específica deles
  • Conduzir o processo ou passar para nosso time central quando necessário
  • Influenciar a direção do produto - você será nosso olhar de varejo dentro da empresa

Você não vai “vender software”.

Você vai conectar experiência com soluções reais.

Para quem é:

Líderes seniores de varejo, incluindo:

  • Gerentes de loja, distrito e regional
  • Líderes de HQ em operações, RH, treinamento, VM, CX ou excelência no varejo
  • Qualquer pessoa que já liderou equipes de varejo e quer dar o próximo passo

Se você já pensou:

“A tecnologia não entende de verdade o que acontece nas lojas” - nós concordamos.

Foi exatamente por isso que criamos a STOREE.AI.

O que oferecemos:

  • Treinamento completo - não é necessário background técnico
  • Trabalho remoto com horários flexíveis
  • Remuneração por comissão, com possibilidade de efetivação full-time
  • Chance de entrar antes de uma grande escala global
  • Tecnologia real, já funcionando no campo

Isso não é um emprego.

É uma segunda carreira.

De comandar lojas para ajudar a definir como as lojas serão comandadas.

Quer começar direto? Inicie o processo aqui.

Nosso site:

title: Engenheiro de dados
description:
Faça parte de uma das maiores empresas de serviços de TI do mundo! Aqui você transforma a sua carreira!

Por que entrar na TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, é por isso que vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado, cheia de oportunidades de melhoria, e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para o nosso sucesso em um ambiente colaborativo.

Estamos procurando por Engenheiro de dados , que queira aprender e transformar sua carreira, em modalidade CLT , presencial em Londrina.

Nesta função você precisa:

O(A) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior é responsável por desenhar, construir e otimizar os pipelines de dados que servem como base para as iniciativas de Business Intelligence e Ciência de Dados da empresa. Este profissional atuará como uma referência técnica, garantindo que as soluções de dados sejam escaláveis, seguras e alinhadas às necessidades de negócio. Sua missão é transformar dados brutos em insights acionáveis, trabalhando em ambientes de alto volume e criticidade para suportar decisões estratégicas em públicos heterogêneos.

Principais Responsabilidades

  • Desenvolver, orquestrar e otimizar pipelines de dados usando Databricks (PySpark, Spark SQL, Delta Lake, SQL Server).
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos, utilizando ferramentas como SSIS (Data Mart)
  • Modelar dados em formatos relacionais e multidimensionais (Star Schema) para otimizar consultas e análises.
  • Atuar como referência técnica para equipes de Ciência de Dados e Análise de Negócio, garantindo o acesso a dados de qualidade.
  • Implementar e gerenciar soluções de Big Data em ambientes cloud, principalmente em Microsoft Azure (Data Lake, Synapse Analytics).
  • Garantir a governança dos dados, aplicando padrões de desenvolvimento, qualidade e segurança.
  • Automatizar processos de carga e replicação de dados, incluindo cenários de real-time.
  • Colaborar na implementação de esteiras de DevOps (CI/CD) para projetos de Analytics e IA.

Formação e Experiência Mínima

  • Experiência mínima de 6 anos atuando diretamente com Engenharia de Dados ou Business Intelligence.
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano atuando diretamente Databricks.
  • Experiência mínima de 1 ano atuando diretamente BW/Data Marts.
  • Estabilidade profissional com média de 2 anos nas últimas experiências registradas no currículo.
  • Formação superior completa e comprovada em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas. Não serão considerados cursos de curta duração ou predominantemente online.

Competências Técnicas (Hard Skills)

  • Sólida experiência em ambientes de dados heterogêneos, críticos e com alto volume.
  • Domínio de modelagem de dados multidimensional (star schema) e relacional.
  • SQL em nível avançado para consultas complexas e otimização de performance.
  • Experiência prática com ferramentas de ETL, preferencialmente SSIS, Azure Synapse Pipelines ou Azure Data Factory.
  • Conhecimento em ecossistemas Big Data (ex: Hadoop) e programação em Python para manipulação de dados.
  • Vivência com soluções de BI e visualização, especialmente Power BI.
  • Experiência com a stack de dados da Microsoft Azure: Azure SQL DB, Synapse Analytics (anteriormente SQL DW), Data Lake Store, e noções de Azure Machine Learning
  • Inglês em nível avançado para leitura técnica e comunicação.

Competências Comportamentais (Soft Skills)

  • Comunicação clara e objetiva para interagir com áreas técnicas e de negócio.
  • Perfil proativo e engajado na resolução de problemas complexos.
  • Capacidade de organização, foco e gestão de prioridades.
  • Atitude colaborativa para trabalhar em equipes multidisciplinares.

Certificações

Obrigatório: Possuir pelo menos uma certificação técnica ativa relacionada à engenharia de dados.

Exemplo recomendado: Microsoft Certified: Azure Data Engineer Associate (DP-203).

Diferenciais (Nice to Have)

  • Experiência com processos de carga e replicação de dados em tempo real (real-time).
  • Conhecimento em outras plataformas de cloud (AWS, GCP).
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines de ETL/ELT robustos, utilizando ferramentas como Azure Data Factory, Synapse Pipelines
  • Experiência com metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban).

Para essa posição se espera que o condidato tenhacomunicação, colaboração, liderança, resolução de problemas, gerenciamento de tempo, habilidades de mentor e criatividade.

description:

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Com uma plataforma de serviços end to end, oferecemos as mais eficientes e inovadoras soluções, tecnologias e metodologias, promovendo uma jornada de transformação para grandes marcas, de diferentes segmentos, no Brasil e no exterior.

Nossos 2.500 mil funcionários atuam no modelo de trabalho Anywhere Office e a empresa é destaque como um dos melhores lugares para trabalhar pelo GPTW e Glassdoor.

No nosso BRQ WAY temos a missão de conectar, transformar e empoderar cada um dos nossos profissionais, que por aqui são chamados de feras, para que todos tenham a chance de usar sua paixão para transformar o mundo com tecnologia!

A BRQ acredita que cada fera deve ser protagonista do seu crescimento, tendo autonomia para criar seu próprio plano de desenvolvimento profissional. Nosso plano de carreira é dividido em 4 pilares:

Carreira técnica: Você pode seguir a trilha de crescimento técnico, se o seu objetivo for se desenvolver cada vez mais em diferentes tecnologias. Oferecemos diversos treinamentos!

Carreira de Liderança: Você pode seguir a trilha e se tornar um líder, desenvolver pessoas, auxiliar na evolução profissional e pessoal e estimular o crescimento para o surgimento de novos talentos.

Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.

Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Atuação híbrida; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Analista de marketing
description:
Sobre a MBRAS

A MBRAS é referência no mercado de imóveis de alto padrão em São Paulo desde 2010. Localizada no icônico Cidade Jardim Corporate Center, a empresa combina sofisticação, estratégia e inteligência de dados para transformar a experiência imobiliária no segmento de luxo.

Mais do que uma imobiliária tradicional, atuamos com consultoria estratégica, gestão de ativos e experiências personalizadas para um público altamente qualificado. Nosso diferencial está na união entre posicionamento premium e marketing orientado por performance, com decisões orientadas por dados e execução impecável.

Com forte presença digital e operação baseada em inteligência de mercado, utilizamos mídia programática, análise de comportamento e segmentação avançada para impactar públicos específicos com precisão. Por meio do exclusivo MBRAS Club e de modelos analíticos próprios, identificamos padrões, antecipamos movimentos e elevamos o padrão do setor imobiliário de luxo.

E aqui, estética importa. Performance também.

Por isso, acompanhamos de perto toda a produção de material: do conceito ao acabamento final. Conteúdo é parte do produto e o padrão visual é um pilar do posicionamento. Fotografia, vídeo, captação, edição e refinamento fazem parte do nosso dia a dia como diferencial real de marca.

Sobre a oportunidade — Analista de Marketing

Buscamos um(a) Analista de Marketing com visão estratégica, capacidade analítica e senso estético apurado para atuar em um ambiente de alto padrão.

Você será responsável por estruturar, analisar e otimizar iniciativas de marketing digital, garantindo crescimento qualificado, eficiência de investimento e suporte estratégico à área comercial — e também por acompanhar a produção e evolução dos materiais criativos (foto e vídeo), assegurando consistência, qualidade e impacto.

A posição combina branding premium, marketing de performance, inteligência de dados e excelência criativa.

Principais responsabilidades
  • Planejar, executar e otimizar campanhas digitais (Google, Meta e outros canais)
  • Monitorar métricas-chave (CAC, ROI, conversão, LTV e qualidade de aquisição)
  • Desenvolver análises e relatórios executivos para apoiar decisões de negócio
  • Gerar insights acionáveis para aumento de performance comercial
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com vendas, produto e liderança para alinhamento estratégico
  • Acompanhar produção de materiais (criativos, fotografia, vídeo e edição), garantindo padrão estético, consistência de linguagem e entrega no nível da marca
  • Coordenar demandas com parceiros/fornecedores criativos quando necessário (captação, edição, motion, etc.)
Perfil que buscamos
  • Forte capacidade analítica e familiaridade com métricas de marketing de performance
  • Experiência com ferramentas de mídia paga e análise de dados
  • Capacidade de transformar dados em decisões estratégicas e ações claras
  • Organização, atenção aos detalhes e alto padrão de execução
  • Bom senso estético e repertório para avaliar/elevar a qualidade de criativos (foto/vídeo/edição)
  • Interesse por mercado de luxo, inovação e comportamento digital

Se você busca um ambiente que combina sofisticação de marca com decisões orientadas por dados, e quer impactar diretamente o crescimento com execução de alto nível, queremos conhecer você.

Sobre a BRQ Digital

Há 32 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Sua missão é entender os desafios e metas de cada clínica, oferecer suporte consultivo e estratégico, e garantir a aplicação das melhores práticas para maximizar os resultados. Esse profissional deve ter visão analítica, forte habilidade de comunicação e foco em soluções, sempre comprometido em gerar impacto real e fortalecer a parceria com os clientes da Escalar Odonto.

Quais são as habilidades ou requisitos necessários?

  • Visão estratégica
  • Relacionamento e comunicação
  • Raciocínio analítico e foco em resultados
  • Alinhamento com a cultura da empresa e visão de longo prazo.
  • Ter alto nível de responsabilidade e organização.

  • Habilidade com novas tecnologias e CRM

  • Experiência com análise de métricas e KPIs

Como será o seu dia a dia:​

  • Participar de reuniões estratégicas para apresentação de resultados, planejamento de ações e ajustes necessários, garantindo a evolução contínua dos clientes.
  • Conduzir reuniões com os colaboradores das clínicas para promover consciência, engajamento e alinhamento de Expectativas com o programa.
  • Conduzir treinamentos de conteúdo técnico da metodologia do programa, quando solicitado.
  • Monitorar o cumprimento de metas e processos, garantindo a aplicação eficaz das estratégias definidas e identificando oportunidades de melhoria.
  • Analisar e identificar gargalos no negócio dos clientes, propondo soluções para otimizar desempenho, faturamento e retenção.
  • Manter contato semanal com os clientes, oferecendo suporte ativo, insights estratégicos e direcionamento para o crescimento da clínica.
  • Esclarecer dúvidas sobre o programa, metodologia e aplicação das estratégias, garantindo alinhamento e engajamento.

description:

  • Strong communication skills: clear, calm, and structured under pressure
  • Ability to anticipate issues, surface risks early, and drive resolution
  • Good judgment in knowing when to act independently vs when to escalate

Project Description:

  • This role coordinates delivery and releases for an in-car accessibility product within an Android-based infotainment system, with a primary focus on meeting legal and regulatory accessibility requirements.
  • Core responsibilities include ensuring compliance, traceability, and correct implementation of accessibility-related changes, while driving quality improvements, defect resolution, and predictable, disciplined releases. Occasional support for new feature development is also expected.
  • Due to the nature of accessibility work, even small changes can have significant user and legal impact, making precision, validation, and strong execution essential. The role operates in a highly complex stakeholder environment, where stakeholders are typically hands-off during day-to-day execution but become highly involved and escalatory when issues arise. Successfully navigating these situations—through transparency, risk anticipation, sound judgment, and resolution under pressure—is a critical aspect of the role.
  • The role works closely with a small team of Android developers. The exact split of responsibilities will be defined once the new hire is onboarded, allowing flexibility based on individual strengths, experience, and evolving product and delivery needs.

Responsibilities:

  • Product & Backlog Management
  • Manage and maintain the product backlog in Jira, with a primary focus on accessibility-related bug
  • fixes, improvements, and release work
  • Support new accessibility features by preparing, refining, and tracking requirements and acceptance
  • criteria with stakeholder
  • Clarify functional, UX, and accessibility requirements with stakeholders and engineering
  • Ensure backlog items are well-defined, testable, and ready for implementation
  • Sprint, PI & Delivery Execution
  • Plan and facilitate sprint and PI activities with the development team
  • Coordinate sprint planning, reviews, retrospectives, and execution tracking
  • Monitor progress, dependencies, and risks across sprints and PIs
  • Sequence and balance work within agreed priorities and constraints to support timely delivery
  • Accessibility, Quality & Change Coordination
  • Coordinate defect fixes, accessibility improvements, and change requests
  • Assess and document impacts, dependencies, and delivery risks, especially where accessibility or
  • compliance may be affected
  • Highlight trade-offs and potential impacts early and transparently
  • Escalate complex or high-impact topics to the appropriate stakeholders
  • Release & Operational Ownership
  • Coordinate end-to-end release activities, including readiness tracking, validation status, and
  • communication
  • Support CI/CD, build, test, and deployment processes in collaboration with engineering
  • Track release quality, regression risks, and production issues
  • Coordinate verification activities on test benches and organize debugging sessions when required
  • Management of test specifications (update existing test specifications if required, create test runs for
  • external testers, etc.)
  • Stakeholder Communication
  • Represent the team and topic in stakeholder meetings, like calls with VW Group brands or
  • representatives of legal and regulatory departments
  • Act as the primary coordination point for day-to-day delivery and release topics
  • Communicate progress, risks, and release status clearly and consistently
  • Support alignment between product, UX, engineering, and validation stakeholders

Job Title: Performance Video Editor & Ad Designer

About the Company:

Our Client is a dynamic organization focused on creating high-conversion advertising content for a variety of social media platforms. They prioritize direct-response advertising and are dedicated to optimizing creative strategies to improve ad performance.

What You’ll Do:

Our Client is seeking a skilled Video and Image Ad Editor to create high-performing advertising content for paid social platforms. The ideal candidate will have a strong background in editing video ads and designing image ads that drive conversions.

Core Responsibilities:

• Edit high-performing video ads for platforms such as Meta (Facebook/Instagram) and TikTok.

• Transform raw footage, UGC, and creator content into conversion-focused ads with strong hooks, pacing, and retention strategies.

• Design compelling image ads that balance typography, hierarchy, and visual clarity to drive clicks and conversions.

• Create multiple creative variations to support testing strategies and improve ad performance.

• Apply on-image text that is clear, scroll-stopping, and aligned with brand voice.

• Ensure all assets are optimized for platform specs, placements, and mobile-first viewing.

Required Experience and Qualifications:

• Proven experience editing video specifically for e-commerce or direct-response advertising.

• Strong understanding of what makes paid social creative convert, including hooks, pacing, captions, CTAs, and pattern interrupts.

• Ability to create a variety of video ad styles (UGC-inspired, promotional, testimonial, feature-focused, offer-driven).

• Demonstrated ability to design high-quality text-driven image ads built to sell.

• Excellent typography skills, including text hierarchy, readability, spacing, and composition.

• Comfortable producing creative at volume without sacrificing quality.

• Proficiency in tools such as Adobe Creative Suite, Premiere, Photoshop, Illustrator, After Effects, or similar.

• Strong attention to detail with the ability to follow best practices and legal guidelines while exploring new creative directions.

• Ability to take direction, implement feedback quickly, and meet deadlines.

Preferred Skills:

• Experience with direct-response formats and UGC-style editing.

• Familiarity with before/after iterations or creative variations.

Personality:

• Creative thinker with a keen eye for detail.

• Adaptable and open to feedback and new ideas.

• Strong communicator with the ability to work well under pressure.

title: HR Plant Manager
description:
We are looking for a HR Plant Manager to join our team in our plant in Brazil (Sete Lagoas/MG) . The chosen candidate will be responsible to execute HR strategy, deal with recruitment, training, and development processes, managing local trends and needs building the best team in line with budget, guidelines and local labor laws and regulations. The role creates a diverse and inclusive ecosystem by leveraging talent management, succession planning and accurate total rewards for the assigned Plant, acting in full alignment with the leader above as well as the coherent with the organization model and HR policy and guidelines. HR Manager ensures accurate execution of cost analysis in line with guidance and leads HR administration and payroll processes being a unique point of contact for labor industrial relations and disputes at the plant level.

Activities

  • Defines, develops, and implements HR programs and plans on annual basis for the assigned sites in alignment HR Strategy defined by CHRO and in alignment with the HR Corporate directives, industrial plan, and budget.
  • Manages staff and recruiting processes, implements compensation and reward strategy, and ensures consistency with the organizational model, in full collaboration with the Regional HR, HR Center of Expertise and CHRO.
  • Analyses the country-specific trends on a regular basis, sharing with regional/corporate actionable inputs and insights and contributing to the definition of sustainable and competitive actions and strategic targets.
  • Ensures the execution of corporate global and local guidelines and procedures, implements promptly and effectively corrective and preventive actions to ensure full alignment and compliance with local law.
  • Executes performance management, training, and development program defined by HR Center of Expertise and provides them prompt and accurate feedback to ensure the effective and sustainable roll-out for the sites assigned.
  • Recruits, develops and retains resources, cultivates high potential talents, enables succession plans.
  • Plans how to cover replaces/covers vacant local positions, implements job enlargement, rotation, and enrichment in line with legal requirements, procedures, budget, business and organization model, and Company guidelines.
  • Creates an inclusive environment and adopts and open-door, encourages employees to speak up as key of success.
  • Provides guidance on HR processes, solves issues in line with legal, HR& Organization and business strategy.
  • Ensures the employee relationship management respects the relevant legal and Labour contract requirements, development, compensation, and benefit guidelines practices, in adherence with the company governances.
  • Provides the plant with HR services, including administration, payroll, and industrial relations, collaborating with the HR team and implementing tools and fair labor practices per labor law.
  • Elaborates and monitors the budget, supervising the related processes at the local level aimed at ensuring cost-effectiveness and company sustainable business growth.
  • Oversees and keeps HR costs effectiveness under control promptly identifying opportunities to exploit, managing risk appropriately, and setting up a contingency plan to foster HR strategy deployment.
  • Manages, coaches, and develops assigned staff, ensuring effective talent management and career path
  • Interacts regularly and effectively communicates and networks with key internal and external stakeholders, to deliver assigned targets as well as to ensure an effective alignment of company objectives and strategic goals.

Mandatory Qualifications

  • 5 years proven experience gained in Human Resources management and +2 years as HR Plant Manager, within international companies
  • Proficiency in English (speaking and writing in English is 40% of daily routine)
  • Graduate in Human Resources, Business Administration, Law or Psychology
  • Knowledge of Talent Management and succession planning techniques
  • Knowledge of Compensation and Total Reward techniques, methodologies, tools
  • Knowledge of HR Management, employment-related laws, trade unions organising and management
  • Knowledge of human resources information systems (HRIS)
  • Change Management
  • Knowledge of Product and Production: process, features techniques
  • Data Analysis and performances metrics: methodologies, techniques, tools and applications
  • Budget management and cost control knowledge
  • Live in Sete Lagoas (work in presence is mandatory)

Preferred Qualifications

  • Advanced knowledge in Excel and Power BI
  • Experience with WCM
  • Experience with ISO standards

About Us

We are a dynamic organization with great customers and a culture where people are valued and empowered to deliver amazing results. We are also growing and looking to hire talented and passionate individuals to join our team!

A Hyundai Motor Company, sediada na Coreia do Sul, está passando por uma transição significativa de ser fabricante de automóveis para se tornar provedora de soluções de mobilidade inteligente. Para acelerar a concretização dessa mudança, estamos investindo em tecnologias inovadoras que transformarão a maneira como as pessoas interagem com suas soluções de mobilidade e melhorarão sua qualidade de vida.

Comprometida com a sustentabilidade, a Hyundai iniciou medidas para liderar uma era de mobilidade mais sustentável eletrificando sua linha de produtos e expandindo seus negócios de hidrogênio para veículos comerciais e dispositivos de utilidade. Atualmente, a empresa atua como sede regional para a América Central e do Sul, exportando do Brasil para Uruguai, Paraguai, Colômbia e México. Com perspectivas promissoras para a região, a Hyundai Motor Brasil, também conhecida como Hyundai Motor Central & South América, está introduzindo tecnologia de ponta de modelos premiados mundialmente, como o IONIQ 5, e avançando para implementar soluções movidas a hidrogênio junto com ações sociais e ambientais para contribuir com as sociedades onde opera na região. Se você aspira fazer parte de uma equipe líder em inovação na indústria automotiva, venha se juntar a nós na Hyundai e faça parte desta jornada rumo ao sucesso.

Movimento audacioso, energia positiva e trabalho de qualidade; este é o nosso DNA Hyundai; este foi o poder que nos permitiu ser líder global na indústria automotiva e será o poder para criar um novo mundo. Estamos em busca de talentos que escreverão uma nova página de nossa história com o DNA Hyundai.

Venha crescer conosco!!!

Sobre a CONSORS:

A CONSORS é uma empresa familiar, pioneira na compra e venda de consórcios em andamento. Trabalhamos com todos os segmentos (imóvel, auto, moto e caminhões), com as maiores e melhores administradoras de consórcio do país. Sem formalidades, ambiente dinâmico, trabalhando direto com os donos da empresa, seu maior desafio será aprender sobre o negócio e obter sucesso na compra de cotas de consórcios. Neste momento, você passará por todos os processos, desde o atendimento comercial de clientes, acompanhamento da negociação, até a conclusão com o processo de transferência de titularidade do consórcio. · Realizar o atendimento comercial de clientes (receptivo e ativo), por meio de whats app e ligações

title: Chatbot Developer
description:
A MYDE busca pessoa desenvolvedora de Chatbot, com experiência em desenvolvimento na plataforma BLIP

Responsabilidades

1. Criação e manutenção de chatbots

  • Projetar, desenvolver e implementar chatbots utilizando o BLiP Builder , ferramenta de construção visual da plataforma.
  • Criar fluxos de conversação (intent-based e baseado em regras) com foco em boa experiência do usuário (UX conversacional) .
  • Configurar blocos, condições, redirecionamentos e conteúdos dinâmicos .

2. Integrações com APIs e sistemas externos

  • Desenvolver integrações com sistemas internos , CRMs, ERPs, ou outras APIs REST para enriquecer a conversa com dados externos.
  • Utilizar scripts em JavaScript nos blocos do chatbot para manipular variáveis, dados e requisições.

3. Treinamento de modelos de IA / NLP

  • Configurar e treinar inteligência artificial para reconhecimento de intenções ;
  • Realizar melhorias contínuas nos modelos de linguagem, analisando erros de entendimento e ajustando as intenções e entidades.

4. Testes e qualidade

  • Realizar testes funcionais dos fluxos conversacionais , incluindo testes de múltiplos caminhos, fluxos alternativos e entradas inválidas.
  • Garantir que o bot responde de maneira adequada, com mensagens claras e apropriadas para o público-alvo.

5. Análise de dados e melhorias

  • Utilizar ferramentas de análise de dados usando SQL ou Phyton para monitorar métricas como número de usuários, retenção, abandono de fluxo, entre outras.
  • Propor e implementar melhorias nos fluxos com base nesses dados.

6. Publicação e manutenção

  • Realizar a publicação do chatbot nos canais de atendimento , como WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, Telegram, Webchat e outros .
  • Fazer a manutenção contínua do bot, incluindo ajustes em fluxos, correção de bugs e implementação de novas funcionalidades.

7. Colaboração multidisciplinar

  • Trabalhar em conjunto com UX , PO, PM, Analistas de Negócios, Customer Success e equipes técnicas .
  • Participar de reuniões de planning, reviews e retrospectivas , principalmente em ambientes ágeis (Scrum/Kanban).

title: JDE CNC Consultant
description:
About Us:

Redfaire is a growing, international technology company headquartered in Limerick, Ireland. Redfaire helps global organisations modernise their JD Edwards environments, migrate to Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI), and unlock value through automation, analytics, and innovation.

Innovation is at the heart of everything at Redfaire, we provide guidance and expertise to our customers in Oracle Cloud, Integrations, AI and Machine Learning.

Headquartered in Limerick, Ireland, we also have offices in UK and USA and a direct presence in other international locations. As a founding partner of Redfaire International, a global network of top-tier JD Edwards consultancies, we’re able to deliver even broader, more impactful solutions to our clients worldwide.

About the Role:

We are currently recruiting a CNC Consultant to join our busy Technical Services Team. The CNC Consultant is responsible for the installation and configuration of JD Edwards EnterpriseOne, including environment setup, user access, security, distributed processing, and version control, as well as testing CNC configurations and controlling software deployment throughout the organisation.

The candidate should have excellent verbal & written communication skills in English & proven analytical and problem-solving skills. The candidate will also need the ability to work in a remote team environment.

Due to the requirement to support our clients in specific time zones, we are seeking appointment of candidates within the LatAm Region.

Responsibilities:

The CNC Consultant role is extremely broad, and responsibilities include (but are not limited to);

  • Oracle ERP (JD Edwards) System Administration, which includes Server and Application Administration, ERP Security Management at user and role level.
  • Planning and installation of business application patches also called electronic software updates or ESUs as well as underlying foundational code or programs called tools releases or service packs
  • Building and deploying changes to the business applications via package management.
  • Management of various business environments & path codes like development, user acceptance testing (UAT) and production, making sure each environment has relevant privileges for users to work with objects in OMW along with required OCM Mapping and Datasources.
  • Ability to Setup and Troubleshoot Printer configuration within JDE, Transform and Print Server
  • Server Manager (the Tools Release 9.1 and above) system management console advance skills.
  • Performance tuning of applications and web servers using Server Manager to analyze kernel processes and obtain log files for detailed analysis.
  • Basic system auditing and performance tuning tasks.
  • Development of software tools and processes to automate repetitive CNC tasks
  • Refreshing and optimization of the underlying database, working with database administrators
  • Experience/expertise with SQL databases such as Oracle, SQL Server with regards to EnterpriseOne
  • Adherence to Redfaire and client Data Protection policies.

Qualifications & Skills:

  • Technical Experience: Minimum 6-7 Years of JDE CNC experience.
  • Expertise in the technical architecture for EnterpriseOne (e.g. Citrix servers, WebLogic servers, WebSphere servers, deployment server, batch/enterprise servers, BSSV servers, mobile apps/AIS servers plus multiple OS's including Windows, Unix/Linux & AS400 can be advantageous)
  • Experience in adding custom environments and custom datasource setups
  • Knowledge of CNC mapping configuration changes using Object Configuration Manager (OCM)
  • Expertise in multiple JDE system software configurations (multi-foundation), Tools Release Updates
  • Relevant 3rd level qualification or equivalent.
  • Excellent communication skills, both verbal & written.
  • Technical competence with proven analytical skills.
  • Problem solving and trouble shooting skills (which requires a wide range of skills beyond JDE CNC skills such as networking, storage, database, operating system, and virtual infrastructures and the ability to work with people who are experts in these areas)
  • Systematic approach to problem resolution.
  • Ability to work independently under one’s own initiative whilst being part of a global team.
  • Proven ability to be adaptable and to respond to constantly changing demands.
  • Ability to work under pressure & to prioritize.
  • Recognise the importance of customer service and strive to deliver high standards.
  • Working knowledge of Microsoft products such as Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook.

What we offer:

  • Career growth within an expanding global award-winning Oracle Partner recognised for excellence.
  • Supportive team culture with ongoing training and mentorship.
  • Competitive salary and benefits package.
  • Opportunity to engage in flexible working arrangements, including remote options, to help you maintain a healthy work-life balance.

Redfaire is an equal opportunities employer. We are committed to building an integrative culture where everyone feels welcomed and supported. Our inclusive workplace provides an environment that will support your development no matter your gender, civil status, family status, sexual orientation, religion, age, disability, education level, or race.

title: Software Developer (C# / .NET | AI & ML Solutions)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Software Developer to join our LATAM Solutions Team and support the development of the next generation of our innovative products, leveraging cutting-edge AI and Machine Learning technologies.


This professional will play a key role in designing, developing, and maintaining customized software solutions on a Windows-based platform, contributing to high-impact digital transformation projects.


Key Responsibilities


  • Design, develop, test, and maintain software applications using C# and .NET.
  • Build and customize solutions on a Windows PC-based platform.
  • Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams to integrate AI/ML capabilities into products.
  • Participate in the full software development lifecycle (SDLC).
  • Ensure high-quality standards through testing, documentation, and code reviews.
  • Optimize system performance, scalability, and security.
  • Contribute to technical decisions and architecture improvements.

  • Strong problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, international environment.

title: Mainframe Storage Engineer (HOME OFFICE)
description:
ITTConnect is seeking a Senior Mainframe Storage Engineer (IBM zOS systems) to work remotely for a client in the US. This is a potentially long term position with a client that is a global leader in consulting, digital transformation, technology and engineering services present in nearly 50 countries. This client is working with one of the major players in the mainframe technology and tools area.


Job location: Remote, work from home anywhere in Brazil .


All interviews will be in English only (must be professionally fluent).


We are seeking an experienced Mainframe System Engineer to join our team and provide operational, consultancy, and migration support in a complex IBM Z environment. The ideal candidate will have deep expertise in mainframe operations, storage administration , and migration projects involving IBM and CA products. This role requires strong technical proficiency, problem-solving skills, and the ability to collaborate effectively across teams to ensure seamless system operations and migrations.


Job responsibilities :

  • Manage and support mainframe operations, ensuring high availability and performance.
  • Provide consultancy and technical assistance for migration projects
  • Implement and configure IBM storage solutions such as DFSMSrmm , DFSMShsm , and related advanced audit and reporting tools.
  • Assist with installation and configuration of IBM OMEGAMON for Storage and other monitoring tools.
  • Develop and maintain JCL scripts, REXX, and Assembler programs for automation and operational efficiency.
  • Utilize TSO and ISPF for system management and troubleshooting.
  • Collaborate with storage administrators to assess migration impacts and provide training/documentation.
  • Ensure compliance with system standards and best practices for SMP/E and z/OS environments.


Key skills :

  • Mainframe Operations Expertise: Minimum 5+ years in mainframe operations, service, or support roles.
  • Proficiency in TSO , ISPF , and JCL .
  • Ability to write REXX and Assembler programs.
  • Experience with DFSMSrmm and/or CA-1 Tape Management System .
  • Hands-on experience with IBM tools such as:

>> IBM OMEGAMON for Storage

>> IBM Advanced Audit and Reporting for DFSMShsm

>> IBM Advanced Catalog Management (ACM)

>> IBM Advanced Allocation Management (AAM)

  • Ability to migrate tools, including the following, within mainframe systems

>> CA-1 to DFSMSrmm migration (configuration, installation, JCL code, runtime parameters).

>> CA FAVER to IBM Advanced Catalog Management migration (customized JCL creation).

>> IBM Global Resource Serialization (GRS) migration (training, PARMLIB member creation,

operational considerations).

>> CA Allocate to IBM Advanced Allocation Management migration (installation, configuration, training).

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills for documentation and stakeholder interaction.


Preferred Skills and Proficiencies:

  • Knowledge of IBM Z system operation and configuration, including SMP/E .
  • Familiarity with competing products and migration strategies.
  • Experience with Storage Administration on IBM Z .
  • Migration experience across IBM and CA products with ability to create customized JCL and runtime parameters.

operational considerations).
